label: illustrative; validate locally
climate_source: NASA POWER cached historical daily climate; uniform illustrative shifts
grid_source: design choice, not empirical; validate locally
distance_rule: Euclidean distance in grid steps from 0 C and 0% rainfall; ties prefer smaller temperature change, then smaller absolute rainfall change
tie_rule: Choose the lexicographically first canonical whole-year rotation among exactly equal feasible objective scores; baseline wins an exact tie with the best feasible rotation

tipping_point.sentence: The top strategy first changes at +0 °C and -30% rainfall (nearest grid cell in normalized steps from unchanged historical weather). The top rotation changes from green_gram then fallow (repeated annually) to fallow then cowpea (repeated annually).

The top strategy first changes at +0 °C and -10% rainfall (nearest grid cell in normalized steps from unchanged historical weather). The top rotation changes from green_gram then pearl_millet (repeated annually) to green_gram then fallow (repeated annually).

The top strategy first changes at +0 °C and -20% rainfall (nearest grid cell in normalized steps from unchanged historical weather). The top rotation changes from maize then green_gram (repeated annually) to maize then common_bean (repeated annually).

The top strategy first changes at +0 °C and +10% rainfall (nearest grid cell in normalized steps from unchanged historical weather). The top rotation changes from green_gram then pearl_millet (repeated annually) to pearl_millet then green_gram (repeated annually).

caveat: Uniform shifts to cached historical daily weather are a sensitivity stress test, not a climate projection. Crop calendars and soil storage stay fixed. Crop and irrigation inputs are illustrative; validate locally.
